dialogue.content: こんばんは。
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ本日相談員を務めさせていただきます華ともうします　宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Good evening. My name is Hana, and I will be your counselor today. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: はい、お名前をお伺いしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes. May I ask your name, please?

dialogue.content: （もう始まってるのですね？）
dialogue.English: (Oh, has it started already?)

dialogue.content: あ　どちらでも結構です
dialogue.English: Ah, either way is fine.

dialogue.content: 咲です
dialogue.English: It's Saki.

dialogue.content: 咲さんですね　ありがとうございますでは、準備が整いましたら　始められても結構ですが。
dialogue.English: Saki, right? Thank you. We can begin whenever you're ready.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。どうぞ始めて下さい
dialogue.English: I'm ready. Please go ahead.

dialogue.content: はい、では改めまして相談員です　今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Alright. Once again, I'm your counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 友人に泥棒扱いされて傷ついてます
dialogue.English: I'm hurt because my friend accused me of being a thief.

dialogue.content: それはまたお辛い思いをされたのですねどのような経緯か　詳しくお伺いしてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: That sounds like a very painful experience. Could you tell me more about what happened?

dialogue.content: 友人５人で旅行に行ったのですが、その時友人の1人のお財布からお金が抜かれて私のせいにされました
dialogue.English: I went on a trip with five friends, and during that time, money was taken from one of my friend's wallets, and I was blamed for it.

dialogue.content: それはビックリしますよね？　仲良しグループか何かしら５名での旅先で起こったのですね？　どうして咲さんが疑われたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That must have been shocking. It happened during a trip with a close group of five? Why do you think they suspected you, Saki?

dialogue.content: どうしてなんですかね…虐めに思えてます
dialogue.English: I don't really know why... It feels like bullying.

dialogue.content: そうですよね　なぜそのような疑いを持たれたのか　気になりますよねそのお財布は何処にあったのですか？
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It must be bothering you, wondering why they would suspect you. Where was the wallet?

dialogue.content: どこにあったのかは分かりません
dialogue.English: I don't know where it was.

dialogue.content: どなたが最初に言い出したのですか？
dialogue.English: Who was the first person to bring it up?

dialogue.content: 3人で言って来ました
dialogue.English: Three of them confronted me.

dialogue.content: その場の状況を詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you describe the situation in more detail?

dialogue.content: 泊まりの部屋は3人、2人に分かれていて、夜トランプをしに3人部屋に行きました翌日、集合してランチをしていたら急にお財布からお金が無くなったんだけど昨夜私の部屋に来たよね。と
dialogue.English: We were split into two rooms for the night, one for three people and one for two. I went to the room with three people to play cards. The next day, when we met up for lunch, they suddenly said, "Money is missing from my wallet. You came to my room last night, didn't you?"

dialogue.content: で、
dialogue.English: And then...

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 親に貰ったお金だから新券なんだけど、あんたの財布見せて。新券だったらあんたが犯人だから。で、私も親から新券でお小遣いを貰ってたので焦りました
dialogue.English: "My parents gave me that money, so it was all new bills. Show me your wallet. If you have new bills, you're the thief." I panicked because I had also received my allowance from my parents as new bills.

dialogue.content: 夜にトランプをするためにお部屋に入っただけで　疑われてしまったのですねそれはビックリしますね
dialogue.English: So you were suspected just because you went into the room at night to play cards. That must have been startling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その財布の新券をチェックされたのですか？
dialogue.English: Did they actually check your wallet for new bills?

dialogue.content: 親友が、そこまでする事？人としても酷い。と止めてくれました
dialogue.English: My best friend stopped them, saying, "Do you really have to go that far? That's a terrible thing to do to someone."

dialogue.content: そうでしたか　勇気あるお友だちがいらっしゃったのですね　それはある意味助かったと思うお気持ちだったのですね
dialogue.English: I see. You had a courageous friend there. You must have felt relieved in a way.

dialogue.content: 助かった。とは思ってませんがかばってくれたのは嬉しかったです
dialogue.English: I wouldn't say I felt "relieved," but I was happy that she stood up for me.

dialogue.content: 実際には無実ではあるけれど、新券を目にすると疑いが持たれていたかもと思ったのですが　その時　咲さんはもしお財布を見られたらどのように説明するつもりだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I imagine you thought that even though you were innocent, they might have suspected you if they saw the new bills. At that moment, how were you planning to explain yourself if they had looked in your wallet?

dialogue.content: 事情を言うまでです
dialogue.English: I would have just explained the situation.

dialogue.content: そうですね　新券だというだけで疑われたのでは　たまりませんよね
dialogue.English: That's right. It would be unbearable to be suspected just for having new bills.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その後　お金を抜かれたお友だちはどうされたのですか？
dialogue.English: What happened with the friend whose money was taken after that?

dialogue.content: 親友が止めに入ってその話しは終わりました
dialogue.English: My best friend stepped in, and the conversation ended there.

dialogue.content: そうですか？　なんとも後味の悪い結果で終わってしまったのですね
dialogue.English: I see. It ended on a rather unpleasant note.

dialogue.content: その後の５人での旅行は楽しめましたか？
dialogue.English: Were you able to enjoy the rest of the trip with the five of you?

dialogue.content: 私はやってませんので、抜かれた子がウソをついてるか、3人の虐めなのか非常に傷ついてます
dialogue.English: I didn't do it, so either the person who said their money was taken is lying, or it's bullying by the three of them. I'm extremely hurt.

dialogue.content: 楽しめませんよ！！
dialogue.English: Of course I couldn't enjoy it!!

dialogue.content: そうですよね　泥棒扱いをされたまま楽しく旅行なんかできないですよね
dialogue.English: Of course. You can't enjoy a trip while being treated like a thief.

dialogue.content: 楽しめたと思われましたか？
dialogue.English: Did you think I could have enjoyed it?

dialogue.content: 前の段階で[その話は終わった]とおっしゃったので、
dialogue.English: It's just that you mentioned earlier that "the conversation ended there,"

dialogue.content: お話が変わるのかと思ってしまいました
dialogue.English: so I thought perhaps the topic had changed.

dialogue.content: 友達がどうしたか。と聞かれたので、その話題は終わった。と
dialogue.English: You asked what happened with my friend, so I said that particular topic ended.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、その続きは　どのような展開になったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How did things unfold after that?

dialogue.content: ただ話題が変わり楽しんでる様には皆はしてましたが私の心はフリーズしたままなので良く覚えてません
dialogue.English: The topic changed, and everyone else acted like they were having fun, but my heart was frozen, so I don't remember much.

dialogue.content: 無理もないですよ　疑われたままで終わっているのですから。
dialogue.English: That's completely understandable. The suspicion was left unresolved.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いや、
dialogue.English: No,

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes?

dialogue.content: 疑われたまま。って…私はやって無いので抜かれた子がウソついてるか、3人の虐めだと感じてるんです
dialogue.English: It's not just "unresolved suspicion"... I didn't do it, so I feel that either the girl whose money was taken is lying, or it's bullying by the three of them.

dialogue.content: その３人の方たちとはどのような関係でお知り合いになったのですか？
dialogue.English: How did you come to know those three?

dialogue.content: クラスメイトです
dialogue.English: We're classmates.

dialogue.content: もう長いおつきあいですか？
dialogue.English: Have you known each other for a long time?

dialogue.content: 3年目です
dialogue.English: It's our third year.

dialogue.content: ３年間は長いと感じられますが、その間の友情はどのように感じていましたか？
dialogue.English: Three years can feel like a long time. How would you describe your friendship with them during that period?

dialogue.content: ３年目ですね
dialogue.English: So, the third year.

dialogue.content: 親友と3人は仲良いですが、私と3人はただのクラスメイトであまり一緒にはいた事は無いです
dialogue.English: My best friend is close with the three of them, but I'm just a classmate to them. We haven't really hung out together much.

dialogue.content: 咲さんの友人を交えての交遊関係だったのですね　それではそこまで親しい間柄ではなかっということですね
dialogue.English: So your interactions with them were through your best friend. In other words, you weren't that close with them, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 友人の方も間に入っていて　このような出来事があったことはショックだったと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine your friend must have also been shocked that this happened, being in the middle of it all.

dialogue.content: でも　咲さんの事を大事に思っているからこそ
dialogue.English: But it's precisely because she cares about you...

dialogue.content: はい、親友は3人と縁を切りました
dialogue.English: Yes, my best friend cut ties with the three of them.

dialogue.content: とても素敵なお友だちだったのですね
dialogue.English: She sounds like a wonderful friend.

dialogue.content: 咲さんの事を信じていらっしゃって
dialogue.English: She truly believes in you.

dialogue.content: はい、誇れる親友です
dialogue.English: Yes, she's a best friend I can be proud of.

dialogue.content: それだけでも救われる気持ちになりました
dialogue.English: That alone must have been a saving grace.

dialogue.content: 私は傷ついたままです
dialogue.English: I'm still hurt.

dialogue.content: 確かに咲さんは　傷は癒されていないと思いますが、
dialogue.English: I understand that your wounds haven't healed, but...

dialogue.content: それ以上に、その友人のお陰で信頼できるお友だちが一人できたことは
dialogue.English: more than that, to have gained one trustworthy friend thanks to this incident...

dialogue.content: この上ない宝物を手に入れたと思っていいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: wouldn't you say that you've gained an invaluable treasure?

dialogue.content: 真の友人はなかなかできないですよ
dialogue.English: True friends are hard to come by.

dialogue.content: 6年目の親友なんで、特にそんな思いはないです
dialogue.English: She's been my best friend for six years, so I don't particularly feel that way.

dialogue.content: 友人も　ちょっとしたことで壊れてしまいますから　大切になさってください
dialogue.English: Friendships can break over small things, so please cherish them.

dialogue.content: え？
dialogue.English: What?

dialogue.content: ある意味ですが、助けてもらって感謝のお気持ちはありませんか？
dialogue.English: In a way, don't you feel grateful that she helped you?

dialogue.content: 傷ついた事で相談に来たのですが…
dialogue.English: I came here to talk about being hurt...

dialogue.content: 刑事の尋問みたいな質問だったり、説教だったり…今、二重に傷ついてます
dialogue.English: But your questions sound like a police interrogation, and you're lecturing me... Now I'm doubly hurt.

dialogue.content: 尋問のつもりは無かったのですね不躾な質問の仕方で申し訳ありません
dialogue.English: I didn't intend for it to be an interrogation. I apologize for my impertinent way of questioning.

dialogue.content: お互い尊重し合い、助けたり支えあったり笑いあったり語りあったりの絆があるから親友出来てる訳で、この事があったから感謝では無く日頃から感謝はありますが？
dialogue.English: We are best friends because we have a bond of mutual respect, helping, supporting, laughing, and talking with each other. It's not because of this incident that I'm grateful; I'm grateful for her every day, you know?

dialogue.content: すみません　お時間がきてしまいましたので終了させていただきますね
dialogue.English: I apologize, but our time is up, so we will have to end the session here.

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
